summary: No sanctions, capital controls, exchange closures or investment bans this week block or restrict any holding in the world, sp500 or ndx100 sleeves. Nothing reaches severity 1 or higher. On 2026-11-09 China's Commerce Ministry extended its suspension of the October 2025 rare-earth and critical-mineral export controls, and the wider US-China truce, to 2027-01-10. That removes a 2026-11-10 cliff, but Beijing can reinstate the measures after January. The US COINS Act outbound-investment proposal (comments due 2026-12-07) folds the 1260H Chinese-military-company list (Alibaba, Baidu, Tencent, BYD, CATL) into the outbound regime. Investments in publicly traded securities remain exempt, and the owner is a Canadian citizen resident in the UAE, not a US person, so there is no direct effect on UCITS holdings. Taiwan saw a record US$28bn foreign outflow in October and central-bank intervention, but no restriction on foreign trading or repatriation. MSCI's open proposal to move Indonesia from Emerging to Standalone status (decision by 2027-06-30; 0.43% of MSCI EM) is relevant to EM lines only; FTSE kept Indonesia at Secondary Emerging, so VWRA is unaffected. No rows are proposed for config/restricted_markets.csv this week.

events.issue: China MOFCOM extended its suspension of the Oct-2025 rare-earth, critical-mineral, battery and superhard-material export controls, and the 24% tariff suspension, to 2027-01-10. The truce was due to lapse on 2026-11-10, and the extension avoids that. The measures can be reinstated after January, and the April-2025 controls on seven rare earths stay in force. This affects trade, not investor market access.

Treasury's COINS Act NPRM (issued 2026-10-22, comments due 2026-12-07) would expand the US outbound-investment ban to Chinese AI and biotech and to firms on the 1260H list (now 188 names, including Alibaba, Baidu, Tencent, BYD and CATL). Investments in publicly traded securities are exempted. The owner is not a US person, so the rule has no direct effect on index funds. Watch the final rule (due by 2027-03-13) and any index-provider response.

Taiwan (about 2% of world) saw a record US$28bn net foreign outflow in October. The central bank sold reserves (now US$596bn) and lifted daily limits on exporters' USD sales. There are no capital controls on foreign investors' trading or repatriation. The 2025 proposals for proof-of-order or T+1 FX for foreign equity investors are unconfirmed.

MSCI consultation proposes moving the MSCI Indonesia Indexes from EM to Standalone status, with feedback until 2027-04-30 and a decision on or before 2027-06-30. MSCI expects to proceed absent clear evidence of improvement, and an index-change freeze on Indonesian securities has applied since Jan 2026. Indonesia is 0.43% of MSCI EM, far below the 5% CON04 gate. The same applies to IEMA.L. FTSE kept Indonesia at Secondary Emerging on 2026-10-06, so VWRA and VFEA are not affected.
